title: Community Food Rescue Program Saves 10,000 Meals
content: Our community food rescue program has successfully saved over 10,000 meals from going to waste this month. Local volunteers have partnered with 50+ stores to redistribute near-expiry food to those in need. The program not only reduces food waste but also strengthens community bonds through shared responsibility and mutual support.

title: New Partnership with Local Farmers Market
content: Foodly is excited to announce a new partnership with the City Farmers Market. Starting this week, fresh produce that would otherwise go unsold will be listed on our platform at up to 70% off. This initiative supports local farmers while making healthy food accessible to more community members.

title: 5 Tips to Reduce Food Waste at Home
content: Reducing food waste starts at home. Plan your meals weekly, store produce correctly to extend freshness, use your freezer for surplus ingredients, compost food scraps, and embrace 'ugly' produce that tastes just as good. Small changes in daily habits can significantly reduce your household food waste footprint.

title: Sustainability Summit 2026: Key Takeaways
content: The annual Sustainability Summit brought together industry leaders, community organizers, and technology innovators to discuss solutions for food waste. Key highlights included the role of real-time technology in reducing retail waste, community-led redistribution models, and policy recommendations for sustainable food systems.

title: How Real-Time Technology is Fighting Food Waste
content: Real-time technology platforms like Foodly are transforming how communities tackle food waste. By enabling instant communication between stores with surplus food and consumers looking for deals, these platforms reduce the time between markdown and purchase, ensuring more food is consumed rather than discarded.

title: Volunteer Spotlight: Meet Our Top Rescuers
content: Every month we highlight community members who go above and beyond in food rescue efforts. This month's top volunteers have collectively rescued over 2,000kg of food. Their dedication shows how individual actions, multiplied across a community, create meaningful impact in reducing food waste.

title: Understanding Food Expiry Labels: Best Before vs Use By
content: Many perfectly good foods are thrown away because of confusion over date labels. 'Best Before' indicates quality, not safety — food is still safe to eat after this date. 'Use By' is about safety. Understanding this difference could prevent thousands of tonnes of unnecessary food waste each year.

title: Major Supermarket Chain Joins Foodly
content: One of the largest supermarket chains in the country has partnered with Foodly to list near-expiry products across 200 locations. This partnership is expected to prevent over 50,000 meals from going to waste monthly and provide significant savings to budget-conscious shoppers.

title: Food Waste in Australia: The Statistics
content: Australia wastes 7.6 million tonnes of food annually — that's 300kg per person. Food waste costs the economy $36.6 billion each year. Meanwhile, 1 in 5 Australians experience food insecurity. Platforms like Foodly bridge this gap by redirecting surplus food to those who need it most.
